title: Google’s Genie 4 world model adds audio, more realistic worlds, and real-time steering
summary: Google DeepMind released Genie 4, a world model with real-time audio, more realistic simulations, and mid-simulation text prompts, in research preview for trusted testers.
investorNote: 交互式世界模型可成为机器人测试和内容制作工具，但要看长时一致性与真实物理迁移。

evidence.quote: Google DeepMind released its newest world model, Genie 4, in research preview on Tuesday.
The model also generates real-time audio that matches the simulated world, including music, ambient noises, and interactive dialogue.
It can maintain a consistent scene for up to two minutes, double its predecessor’s limit

displayTitle: Google DeepMind 发布 Genie 4 研究预览，世界模型可实时改场景
narrative: Google DeepMind 发布 Genie 4 研究预览。TechCrunch 核对的新能力包括同步生成环境音与对话、在模拟运行中用文本改变场景，以及最长约两分钟的一致性维持；Gemini 参与规划与检查。它把世界模型更接近交互式仿真，但目前仍是受限研究预览，不能把演示中的机器人用途等同于已验证的现实控制能力。

eventRelation.reason: Genie 4 当天研究预览是独立于旧版本 Genie 3 的新模型发布。
